newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Cosmos down 3.57 pct on profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Cosmos down 3.57 pct on profit taking.

text.p: Cosmos Bottling Corp shed 15 centavos, or 3.57 percent, to 4.05 pesos a share in late trade in Manila on Wednesday on profit-taking, brokers said.
"Its really profit-taking. The issue has been going up the past few days," Noel Reyes, research head at Anscor Hagedorn Securities Inc said.
Cosmos hit a year-high of 4.20 on Tuesday on prospects of increased production.
Cosmos said its acquisition of another bottling facility from rival RC Cola will beef up its production.
Some 3.613 million Cosmos shares had changed hands by late trade.
